properties.name: chartStyle
properties.description: Selects a coordinated set of defaults. Explicit properties can override the selected preset.

properties.name: usesCustomChartStyle
properties.description: Indicates that the stored appearance no longer matches the selected preset. Renderers still resolve every explicit property.

properties.name: showYAxis
properties.description: Shows the numeric axis, its values, and its tick marks.

properties.name: showXAxis
properties.description: Shows labels and tick marks for the data-point categories.

properties.name: tintColor
properties.description: Overrides the theme chart tint. An omitted or null value uses the current theme.

properties.name: highlightLargestBar
properties.description: Keeps the largest bar at full opacity and visually de-emphasizes the others.

properties.name: barTopCornerRadius
properties.description: Rounds the two upper corners of each bar in platform points or density-independent pixels.

properties.name: usesGradient
properties.description: Uses a tint-derived gradient instead of a flat chart fill or stroke treatment.

properties.name: lineWidth
properties.description: Sets the line thickness in platform points or density-independent pixels.

properties.name: showGridLines
properties.description: Draws chart-aligned grid lines when at least one axis is visible.

properties.name: showSymbols
properties.description: Draws a visible symbol at each line or area data point.

properties.name: yAxisPosition
properties.description: Places the numeric axis at the leading or trailing edge for the active layout direction.

properties.name: interpolation
properties.description: Selects how a line travels between consecutive data points.

properties.name: dataPoints
properties.description: Supplies ordered chart data. Each point has label and value; range charts also use minValue and maxValue.

properties.name: highlightedDataPointIndex
properties.description: Selects a donut segment by data-point index. Renderers move the selected segment radially outward and emphasize its legend entry.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Category label displayed on the x-axis when that axis is visible.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Primary numeric value for bars, lines, areas, and accessible chart descriptions.

properties.name: minValue
properties.description: Lower bound used by range charts.

properties.name: maxValue
properties.description: Upper bound used by range charts.

compatibility.note: Writers of document version 2 use only canonical property names. The misspelled v1 alias is accepted only during migration.
